ops.title: FP EDEADLK Stage-0 verdict: frozen replicas = lazy content policy, not consent
ops.body:
Stage-0 diagnosis of the 2026-07-14 FP EDEADLK incident (plan: looks-like-we-broke-glowing-kahan), established live before Stage-1 implementation dispatched.

**Frozen-anchor verdict.** The fleet-wide stale settings.json replicas are NOT a failing appex lstat and NOT the group-container consent re-prompt. Census evidence (local Mac, 12 FP accounts): 9 replicas frozen at Jul 12 03:04; acct-04 refreshed Jul 12 22:17, acct-06 Jul 13 15:28, acct-15 Jul 14 04:03 — the scatter matches *last actual use of each account*, not signal times. Signals fired unconditionally every ~3.5 min throughout. Conclusion: under FP's default **lazy content policy, a materialized item is never re-downloaded until something touches it**, so enumerator signals alone never refresh launch-critical replicas; the client-side version hash (appex lstat) plus fusekit Sync/Health swallowing ErrAppUnavailable made the staleness silent. Fix set confirmed: P6 (.downloadEagerlyAndKeepDownloaded on computed settings.json/.claude.json), P1(d) server-side manifest versions, P1(b)/P2 observable + change-driven signals.

**Consent hypothesis weakened (yasyf-home).** After its fileproviderd restart (04:04, pid 39511), a plain read of acct-11/settings.json succeeded and launched 6 appexes at 04:16:41 — appexes reach the group container and the bridge fine (local appex logs show "Consumed sandbox extension" + app-group lookups succeeding). The Jul-12 cask upgrade's cdhash consent re-prompt was NOT the failing hop. All 6 FP replicas there were uniformly stale at Jul 13 22:12 (when its signal path died); delete-item churn fell to 12/10min, ENOMEM 0.

**Remediation applied.** Local: fileproviderd killall 03:21 (wedge cleared); host app self/user-restarted 03:40 → convergence resumed on next base change (acct-15, 04:03). yasyf-home: fileproviderd killall 04:04; stale Jul-12 host app bounced 04:21 (new pid 1869) to restore the signal path. Neither local frozen replica is dataless (st_flags = UF_TRACKED only); full convergence expected only after the v0.55.0 eager-policy fix — stale-until-touched is the pre-fix steady state.

Stage 1 implementation: workflow wf_a00994d0-d79 (lanes fp-fix/lane-f fusekit, lane-g/lane-w/lane-s cc-pool).
